findings.detail: Availability campaign uses _simulate_request() which generates synthetic latency via random.gauss(). No actual HTTP calls to the inference service. Observations are NOT from real model inference.
Scanner integration code exists but tools are not installed. No actual scanner output has been produced. RQ3 evidence is missing.

Tables are generated from analysis_results.json which is computed from raw campaign files. Availability data traces to synthetic observations (MOCK_ONLY). Security data traces to real policy evaluation (REAL_EVIDENCE).
